name: Peet's Coffee Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Sandwich (Plain Soft Brioche)
whyItWorks: Cage-free folded egg patty and aged sharp cheddar cheese on a soft brioche bun. Naturally low in lactose, non-spicy, and avoids greasy bacon or sausage patties.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Egg & Cheddar Sandwich warmed. If stricture-sensitive, check bun crust and eat soft interior.
